articles.title: Jason Momoa Reflects on Getting Beat Up by Timothée Chalamet in Dune: Part 3
articles.summary: Jason Momoa, if you hadn't noticed, is a much bigger man than Timothée Chalamet. In Dune: Part 3, however, size doesn’t matter.
articles.body:
Jason Momoa, if you hadn't noticed, is a much bigger man than Timothée Chalamet. In Dune: Part 3 , however, size doesn’t matter.

Chalamet plays Paul Atreides in Dune: Part 3, which takes place 20 years after the events of the previous movie. Atreides is well established as the most powerful being in the universe, a messianic, totalitarian leader who can stab people real good.

Momoa kind of returns as a clone of his previous character from Dune: Part 1, Duncan Idaho, who doesn’t share any of his DNA dad’s memories or personality traits. “It’s probably the weirdest character I’ve ever had to navigate, because I know I was hired to play Duncan for a certain reason, then I had to figure out how to play a guy who doesn’t know who the guy is,” Momoa said in an interview with NY Times .

Dune: Part Three Trailer Images (August 2026)

“It was very challenging. I’m not the most subtle actor, or human, so it was probably my most subtle performance. I haven’t seen it yet. I don’t know which takes he used.”

While Idaho and Atreides were close friends in Part 1, there’s more of a strain to that relationship in Part 3 and the pair come to blows. According to Momoa, it was challenging to wrap his head around the logistics of losing to Chalamet.

“And another thing too, working with Tim, I have to fight him,” Momoa explained. “[His character Paul] is at a whole other level, and better than me as a fighter. And you know, realistically, how do we put that together?”

Chalamet cut in to say that was “a polite way of putting” that Momoa could take him in a fight in real life. “He’s a better actor,” Momoa said. “I’m better at fighting. But he’s really fast. I was super impressed: Just because you’re a great actor, it doesn’t mean that you’re able to dance. Ultimately, it’s a dance.”

Elsewhere in the lead up to launch, we’ve had a look at Dune: Part 3’s horrific popcorn buckets . One comes with two sandworm holes for double the fun, and the other comes with a thumper that actually moves up and down.

Dune: Part 2 surpassed the previous movie in the trilogy at the box office , generating almost $500 million. Dune: Part 1 grossed $433 million worldwide during its entire theatrical run. Dune: Part 3 is scheduled to release in cinemas on December 18, 2026, with early IMAX preview screenings beginning on December 14, 2026.

articles.title: Japanese News Show Features Drinkable Street Fighter Trading Cards
articles.summary: A Japanese news show claims it’s found the next popular thing in Japan: drinkable Street Fighter 6 trading cards. Each card contains a shot of energy, 12ml to be precise, and features designs from Capcom’s fighting game roster.
articles.body:
A Japanese news show claims it’s found the next popular thing in Japan: drinkable Street Fighter 6 trading cards. Each card contains a shot of energy, 12ml to be precise, and features designs from Capcom’s fighting game roster.

You simply fold one of the cards in half, which is a statement that would usually make a card collector wince, and sup the little juice droplet from the center. The cards are called Energy Arts and the news clip showed designs for Ryu, E. Honda, Dhalsim, Jamie, and Vega. Here’s the clip:

A Japanese news show featured drinkable trading cards in its ranking of possible hit products for 2027. Each card contains 12ml of an energy drink and the card/drink company already has a collab with Capcom's Street Fighter. — Jeffrey J. Hall 🇯🇵🇺🇸 (@mrjeffu) November 4, 2026

A Japanese news show featured drinkable trading cards in its ranking of possible hit products for 2027. Each card contains 12ml of an energy drink and the card/drink company already has a collab with Capcom's Street Fighter.

The news channel predicted that the product will be a big thing in Japan in 2027. According to the show’s ranking, the Energy Arts cards come in fifth, behind this mysterious collection of odd names: Human Certificate, Fresh Food Crane Game, Muse Charm, and Edible Cactus “Sabo-Vege.”

Energy Arts cards were originally announced earlier in the year. The official press release said there are 24 cards to collect, and the idea behind the product was to “overturn the conventional idea of drinking” with what it called a “smart replenishment.”

It was created with esports players in mind, letting them get in a little sustenance and energy between rounds without taking time out for things like “drinking” a bottle of water.

“Whether you're playing a game, taking an exam, attending a meeting, or driving — in situations where concentration is required, the fact that refueling = interruption of concentration is a challenge for many people,” said the press release.

Instead of relying on caffeine like most energy drinks, the formula is built around what the company calls “fast-acting amino acids.” Apparently, the small quantity of juice inside cuts down on “the toilet problem,” because your bladder will probably barely register it.

You can leave the cards unsupped for 18 months before the drink inside turns bad. I don’t know what the process is for keeping them as a collectible if you don’t want to bend them or unseal them in any way.

articles.title: Xbox overhauls its PC, web, and cloud apps with a faster design
articles.summary: Microsoft is overhauling its Xbox PC app and Xbox Cloud Gaming design. A new, faster UI is rolling out to testers.
articles.body: Microsoft is unveiling a new Xbox PC app that launches “up to 60 percent faster” than before, with an overhauled design to match new updates to Xbox Cloud Gaming on the web and smart TVs. Xbox Insiders will be able to start testing the updated Xbox PC app today, and the updated Xbox Cloud Gaming interface will start rolling out over the next few weeks. Ever since Microsoft launched its Xbox Ally handheld devices last year, it was clear the Xbox PC app still needed a lot of work to feel more like an Xbox console experience on Windows. Microsoft has greatly simplified the app now, with a design that no longer feels like you’re clicking a mouse when you’re using a controller. [Image: The new Xbox PC app has been redesigned to run faster. “The app now launches up to 60 percent faster,” says Jason Beaumont, VP of Xbox experiences. “Pages like Home, Store, and Game Pass load up to 50 percent faster, and in-app windows open up to 65 percent faster.” The Xbox PC app also has simplified navigation that should make it easier to use on a controller, and the library section now has updated filters and better ways to organize your installed games. Microsoft has improved the social parts of the Xbox PC app, too, with friends now listed in the main page and quick buttons to start a chat or join a party. The app overall feels less like a web one now, with what appears to be a mix of native and web elements. Microsoft has also refreshed the game card UI, as well as the home and settings sections. Even the animations have been updated to make this feel more like an Xbox dashboard experience. [Image: The new Xbox Cloud Gaming web experience is similar to the Xbox PC app. I’ve been using this new Xbox PC app for the past few weeks, and it’s noticeably faster on a variety of devices I own. I’ve found it’s much easier to navigate around with a controller, and the search interface no longer tries to pop up when you’re moving between sections. I understand Microsoft is looking to improve that in the coming months, and there should be design updates to make it match more closely to this updated Xbox PC app. This new UI is also coming to Xbox Cloud Gaming. “We’re also bringing the refreshed Xbox web experience to more players and rolling out updates to Xbox Cloud Gaming apps on supported TVs and VR headsets,” says Beaumont. “These changes are part of our work to make Xbox faster, simpler, and more familiar wherever you play.” [Media: The refreshed web version of Xbox Cloud Gaming has a similar look and feel to the Xbox PC app. A new library tab highlights cloud games across your own library and Xbox Game Pass. Target's early Black Friday sale has kicked off for 2026 and one of the best deals so far is on a surprising Pokémon product. The Puppetronics Pikachu was released earlier this year as part of Pokémon's 30th anniversary celebrations and this is the first big discount we've seen on it. Animatronics are a bit of a mixed bag, even if they are Pokémon-themed. On one hand they are a really cool gift for a kid who just wants the closest thing to a real-life Pokémon. On the other hand, they just feel a bit haunted. There's a reason the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise is so popular and it's because it feeds into a very real fear.

That being said, I have heard nothing but positive reviews about this little guy from friends who have bought it themselves. It's movements and sounds are triggered by motion and touch and there's very little reason to believe it will ever gain any sentience beyond that. It also comes in a box that doubles as a display case if you don't plan on playing with it too often. The company behind this product, Jazwares, are the same people who created the very popular Squishmallows.

Target's early Black Friday sale is one of the first of many Black Friday sales to come. Amazon has also recently joined the early Black Friday club with discounts on Pokémon DVDs and Blu-rays well ahead of Thanksgiving. So if you're looking to shop for gifts for the Pokéfan in your life, right now is a surprisingly good time to start browsing.

articles.title: We Build LEGO Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird, the First KPop Demon Hunters Set
articles.body:
KPop Demon Hunters is one of the biggest success stories of the streaming era, so it’s no surprise that Netflix (eventually) made a collaboration with LEGO. Now, we’ve finally gotten our hands on the first official set from the collaboration: LEGO Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird.

I, like many of us, have had "Golden" stuck in my head for two years now. I rewatched the movie before breaking open the new set, and had quite a few questions going into the build.

How does it capture the spirit of the movie without HUNTR/X? What’s the target audience here, adult collectors or younger fans? And how exactly do the plastic bricks capture the slightly off-putting but nonetheless endearing charm of the tiger and magpie, a duo rooted in Korean art history?

LEGO KPop Demon Hunters: Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird

Off the rip, I was shocked to discover the instruction booklet jumped right into, well, instructions. Sometimes LEGO will offer some sort of blurb about what inspired the build or how the designers approached adapting a specific IP. In this case, I think a blurb would've had a lot to offer.

In the movie, we first meet the Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird after Jinu discovers Rumi is part demon, and decides to connect with her one-on-one to discover "her shame." Jinu sends the creatures in his place, who proceed to deliver small messages whenever he or Rumi want to meet.

The supernatural duo become how the part and full demon communicate with one another, while humanizing Jinu and offering some solid comedic relief. Their specific names aren’t actually mentioned in the movie, and instead come from internal conversations referencing the Gen Z slang "derp" and "sus."

The popularity of the two creatures isn't surprising. Unlike the somewhat sanitized designs we often see in newer Pixar and DreamWorks movies, Sony wasn’t afraid to get a little creepy with it.

The movie doesn’t offer a whole lot of explanation for the supernatural creatures. They’re tied to Jinu, and seem to obey him rather than Gwi-Ma. They still appear after HUNTR/X builds a new Honmoon, hinting at their relative independence, or, potentially, Jinu’s return .

The tradition of the tiger and magpie actually long pre-dates KPop Demon Hunters. The duo is inspired by traditional jakhodo paintings, popularized in the late Joseon era as artists depicted a bold-eyed tiger alongside a keen-eyed magpie, symbolizing strength, fortune, and good luck.

Just one Google search will show just how many articles and exhibitions about this history have popped up since the Demon Hunters explosion, aligning with the vision of the film's creator, Maggie Kang. "I wanted every part of this movie to be Korean," Kang said in an interview with Deadline , highlighting the efforts that went into maintaining "specific" cultural accuracy.

I’m of the opinion LEGO had an opportunity for some edu-tainment with this set, and my biggest criticism is that they didn’t do something with this context. Whether you agree depends on your perspective on LEGO’s 'responsibility' as a brand, because what I will say is they nailed the actual brick-building.

Once you open the box, you’ll immediately notice lots of blue. The Sussie Bird timeline at the bottom of the instructions offers a pretty clear sense of the breakdown of the build: around 90% tiger. Because just about every piece is some shade of blue, you have to pay close attention to the hue of individual pieces — I had to restart at least one section over a light blue shade mix-up.

What you don’t have to deal with is stickers. Every detail of the set, including Derpy’s eyes, nose, claws, are printed directly onto corresponding plastic bricks.

As for the build itself, you start with a base for the body, then work on layers for the two bottom and two front paws. Each paw gets four printed claws, and has a decent amount of mobility once attached to the body with hinges. You also build a curved tail, which is surprisingly sturdy and capable of supporting itself.

Derpy Tiger’s striped head is the bulk of the build. Once complete, it can turn on a full axis, owl-style. Some interesting layering effects for the teeth, ears, and eyes allow the build to capture a pretty one-to-one depiction of the whimsical creature.

There’s also no mistaking Derpy Tiger’s psychedelic orange and pink eyes. I do think printed graphics was the way to go for this set, though a massive 37,000 piece Derpy Tiger build shows how one LEGO designer tackled the haunting look with pure bricks.

Once you have your Derpy Tiger base, the rest of the details come together pretty quickly.

The first version of Derpy Tiger you build has his mouth closed, showing his bottom teeth in a creepy smile. However, you can swap out the bottom row of teeth for a tongue that can be attached to small letters, much like how the character shares notes between Rumi and Jinu in the film. The LEGO version provides two letter variants: Jinu’s first “Hello Friend,” and Rumi’s later “Save the Date.”

I’m greedy and prone to losing things, so I couldn’t help but wonder if there was some way to have a little movement here. Ideally, the set would let you open the mouth and reveal the tongue as opposed to swapping out the mini-builds, which can get a bit finicky. As a workaround, you can remove a section of Derpy Tiger’s head to store your extra pieces. It feels a little violent, but I suppose it works.

Sussie Bird comes together with about a dozen smaller pieces, and can be planted firmly on top of Derpy Tiger’s head. He gets his full set of ominous yellow eyes, and of course, his special little hat. In Jinu’s words, “I made it for the tiger, but the bird keeps taking it.”

Then there’s the plant. I get it, it’s a solid reference to the clumsy tiger continuously knocking over the shrub in Rumi’s room. It made for an intriguing teaser video when LEGO first revealed the set, but in reality, it’s a little bit awkward. Derpy and Sussie look great as a decorative duo, but I can’t imagine I’ll know where I put the little standalone plant after a month or so.

One 'criticism' I’ve seen floating around online is, well, it’s been two years since KPop Demon Hunters came out, so the LEGO collaboration feels a little slow to the draw. That criticism is easily explained.

It’s no secret that Kpop Demon Hunters wasn’t expected to be a big hit. The straight-to-streaming release had relatively minimal marketing, and thrived from word-of-mouth and, of course, some Netflix homepage placement. As such, it’s not surprising that merchandise is taking a little longer to come to market. In the words of one Reddit user , “we’re seeing the manufacturing timeline in real-time.”

On the plus side, it’s extremely unlikely that this is the beginning and end of LEGO’s take on the KPop Demon Hunters. Netflix has been a consistent collaborator for the brick-building giant, which has released multiple sets based on other Netflix Originals like Wednesday and One Piece .

Rumors are already pointing to several smaller KPop Demon Hunters sets coming in Spring 2027. I imagine these will involve a more literal translation of HUNTR/X and the Saja Boys, possibly as minifigures. There’s a lot of potential with the various "stages" each group performs on throughout the movie, but my biggest hope is that the next set offers a little more interactivity for younger fans.

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: Wendy's RPG WendyQuest Offers Real Food Rewards for Beating Boss Fights
articles.summary: Wendy’s has gone full Wendy’s, releasing a 15-hour RPG based on the fast-food chain’s branding.
articles.body:
Wendy’s has gone full Wendy’s, releasing a 15-hour RPG based on the fast-food chain’s branding.

We were caught off guard by trailers showing some genuinely compelling turn-based gameplay , but the full launch of WendyQuest has brought yet another surprise: real rewards for beating bosses.

Every time you defeat a Mech Boss, the game will reward you with one 'Corner Stone,' which comes with a unique code. Enter the code into the 'Offers' tab on the Wendy’s app, and you’ll get a chance to win one of the following food rewards:

There are five Mech Bosses in the game, which gives you a total of five chances to score one of the rewards. Unfortunately, repeat encounters don’t appear to net additional codes.

WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones Screenshots

The rewards aren’t entirely free — to actually redeem them, you’ll have to make a "separate qualifying purchase." Classic, I know. Reward eligibility is limited to U.S. residents who are 18 and older, and players have seven days after redeeming a code in-app to complete an order before it expires.

The real-life rewards will endure "while supplies last," indicating the promotion may be time-limited. It would be kind of wild if it was a permanent fixture of the Wendy’s brand, but you never know. The company just released their third-quarter financials , reporting a 7.6% decline in U.S. systemwide sales and 5.3% decline in same-restaurant sales, and has been going all-in on the marketing stunts to try and make up some ground.

WendyQuest: Legend of the Four Corner Stones launched as a free-to-play game on Steam, Android, and iOS devices on November 4, hitting a peak player count of just shy of 400 on Steam. Launching at the same time as the Ocarina of Time remake was an interesting choice, to say the least, and makes WendyQuest one of the few games releasing in the month of GTA 6 .

I can’t believe you guys made a retro RPG called WendyQuest that you can download now. Oh wait that was us. — Wendy’s (@Wendys) November 4, 2026

I can’t believe you guys made a retro RPG called WendyQuest that you can download now. Oh wait that was us.

The full RPG includes around 15 hours of content, equivalent to recent AAA releases like Marvel's Wolverine. You control the red-haired Wendy, recruiting allies to stop the evil Mech Corp and save the land of Savoria.

The Mech Corp empire, under the control of Dr. MechBorg, runs with a capital 'M' logo and is all about cutting corners to earn billions, likely a direct hit at a classic Wendy’s competitor, McDonald’s. In-game abilities and items are all based on classic Wendy’s food items, with unique damage types like "Crispy," "Frosty," and "Fresh Beef."

WendyQuest was developed in collaboration with 81monkeys, a Canadian-based company, based on the 2D style of turn-based JRPG classics like Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy. As more and more games launch with full AI use disclosures, the WendyQuest Steam listing proudly proclaims the game as "100% fresh and 100% human made."

Will a solid RPG experience inspire people to eat more Wendy’s? We’ll have to see.

articles.title: 52-Year-Old YouTuber Learns Karate by Studying Tekken to Train With His Son
articles.summary: A 52-year-old Japanese YouTuber is learning karate by studying characters’ moves from Tekken after his son inspired him to pursue a journey in martial arts.
articles.body:
A 52-year-old Japanese YouTuber is learning karate by studying characters’ moves from Tekken 3 after his son inspired him to pursue a journey in martial arts.

AskJapan is a fairly popular YouTuber with more than 189,000 subscribers. He’s best known for his vlog-style videos where he chats with viewers and plays retro video games on old-school consoles, often while dressing up in low-budget cosplay of characters from the games he’s playing.

He’s been on a fighting game stint lately, taking on the likes of Street Fighter II and Tekken 3 , the latter of which he’s using to help himself learn real-life martial arts moves. He explained this newfound interest in a November 3 video , saying one of his son’s recent karate demonstrations made him inspired to try it out for himself.

AskJapan says that his son is a brown belt, a rank that’s right beneath the black belt (the top level that signifies total mastery of the art). He’s only 10 years old, and has been training since he was 5. This fact, combined with his son’s latest “overwhelming” karate demonstration, made him want to try it out for himself. But rather than hitting the dojo first, AskJapan is taking an unconventional approach to the art; he’s taking ‘lessons’ from Tekken characters.

“His performance inspired my spirit, my motivation,” the YouTuber explained. “I thought, ‘Okay, maybe someday in the future, I [can] start karate, even though I’m 52. Why not? I realized that, to start, I have to practice karate with games. That’s why I was determined today, after watching my son’s performance this morning. Why not start today, and practice with Tekken? This is my way of improving.”

Throughout the rest of the video, he took notes from Tekken 3 as he played through the game on a homemade ‘arcade cabinet’ that he’d fashioned out of cardboard. It’s an extremely charming watch — but his second foray into the game was downright hilarious.

His next video , which he uploaded on November 4, shows him fashioning a Heihachi cosplay out of a helmet and cardboard paper. His goal was to unlock the boss character by attempting to beat Tekken 3’s arcade mode, but he unfortunately failed.

Fans are rallying behind the YouTuber on his latest mission, sharing words of encouragement for both his martial arts goals and his journey to becoming a better Tekken player.

“There is no age to start karate, and you still look in shape,” one viewer wrote.

“I hope Harada and the gang see this and appreciate it like I do,” another said, referencing the former Tekken boss .

It’s true that having martial arts experience can come in handy; earlier this year, a member of the fighting game community went viral for using skills he’d learned from sumo wrestling to fend off a knife-wielding man at his local gaming cafe. And despite the shocking ordeal, he returned to his Twitch stream straight afterward, complaining that the incident had cost him 14 LP in League of Legends .

articles.title: How to Defeat Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents in Phantom Blade Zero - Phantom Blade Zero Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents is a story boss in Phantom Blade Zero, and he appears at the end of the Snake's Reflection main quest. He's
articles.body:
Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents is a story boss in Phantom Blade Zero , and he appears at the end of the Snake's Reflection main quest. He's the fourth and final story boss you encounter in the Crimson Forest. Here are a few tips and strategies for how to beat her.

How to Defeat Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents

Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents Boss Phase 1

Walk toward the giant tree in front of the Threadbound Great Tree bell to trigger a scene that leads into a fight against Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents . She’s the major final boss in the Crimson Forest.

These are the special moves you need to be aware of:

Bai Chilian is a boss who uses swift movements and teleportation to catch you off guard. She loves to use spinning attacks and quick, multi-hit combos in between teleports around the battlefield.

Bai Chilian’s serpents also cause a lot of trouble because they can attack simultaneously alongside her. Sometimes, the best course of action is to block when overwhelmed in a combo or reposition with multiple dodges when surrounded.

Don’t be too passive offensively! You can interrupt Bai Chilian’s combos, especially when she reappears from a teleport. If you get the timing down, you can hit her as she reappears to briefly stop her from attacking. Don’t try to pull off full combos in these instances, though. One or two hits is all you’ll get safely.

Keep in mind that certain Power Surges are also invincible on startup, so you can use the Outlaw Warblade’s Power Surge to heal in nearly any situation during this phase as long as it connects with the boss.

Bai Chilian, the Sacrificial Serpent Boss Phase 2

The boss regains all her health after you fully deplete her HP, and she returns as Bai Chilian, the Sacrificial Serpent. She’s got several new moves here, and they’re listed below.

Bai Chilian still has her spinning slashes and floaty combos, but she loses her teleport. She also gains a lot of range with her serpent limbs in this phase. Thankfully, you gain an unexpected ally during this half of the fight.

There’s no need to chase Bai Chilian around the arena. Instead, wait until she comes to you with her color-coded lunges. Parry or dodge when necessary to create counterattack opportunities. Your biggest opening on offense comes when Bai Chilian is guard-broken.

However, you should use your ranged Phantom Edges, like the Flying Dagger or Feather Bow, if you have one equipped. The Flying Dagger can even inflict poison.

After the battle, a scene plays, showing you the betrayal that Zuo Shang orchestrated against the Chord and Yuyin. You also obtain the Broken Illusory Pipa story item and the White Serpent & Crimson Viper main weapon (Dual-Wield).

The White Serpent and Crimson Viper can perform an endless Sha-Chi combo, ranged attacks, and can even orbit Soul as he performs other attacks. These all consume Sha-Chi. The Power Surge is an unblockable attack.

You’re rewarded with the Resonance Talisman accessory as well. It increases Sha-Chi by 15%.

articles.title: It's Official: Marvel Has Finally Undone the Controversial Spider-Man - One More Day Storyline
articles.summary: The day Spider-Man fans have been waiting 20 years for has finally arrived - Marvel Comics has undone the controversial Spider-Man: One More Day storyline.
articles.body:
Full spoilers follow for Captain America #16 and The Avengers #1!

The day Spider-Man fans feared would never come has finally arrived. Marvel Comics has officially started the process of undoing 2007's Spider-Man: One More Day. The hugely controversial storyline that saw Peter Parker and Mary Jane Watson sacrifice their marriage to save Aunt May is being undone after nearly 20 years of continued controversy.

How did Marvel finally undo One More Day? And what does this mean for Spidey going forward? Let's break down what we know right now.

There have certainly been signs recently that Marvel was finally preparing to undo One More Day . In particular, the ending of Avengers: Armageddon teased an imminent showdown between Mephisto and Spider-Man. Armageddon writer Chip Zdarsky has wasted no time in following up on that thread in his other Marvel books.

The first step in reversing One More Day came in Captain America #16. The series has recently been telling a story parallel to the events of Armageddon, with a comatose Steve Rogers having his soul dragged to Hell by Doctor Doom (who's been trapped there ever since the end of 2025's One World Under Doom). Doom enlisted Cap in a fight to depose Mephisto and install a new, more benevolent ruler of Hell.

True to form, Doom is always looking out for number one, and the end result is that he himself is now the master of Hell. However, he has no desire to be the warden of an otherworldly prison. Doom frees all of Hell's souls, wishing that only those who wish to follow him remain. He even releases the soul of his lover, Valeria. As for Mephisto himself, he flees his domain and makes a beeline for the safety of the mortal world.

This marks a major status quo shift for the supernatural corner of the Marvel Universe. The most immediate effect from Doom's ascension is that all deals made with the previous ruler of Hell are now null and void. That includes a bargain struck between Mephisto and a certain wallcrawling superhero.

Step 2: Spider-Man Remembers His Bargain

That Captain America twist immediately carries over into the pages of Zdarsky and Marco Checchetto's relaunched Avengers comic. With Mephisto deposed, an army of angelic warriors descend upon New York City and begin attacking everyone who ever made a deal with Mephisto, be it for eternal youth or whatever else.

The angels seem to have a specific target - a girl named Paige whose mother and grandfather made a bargain with the demon lord. Paige is given a mysterious talking book and told to track down Spider-Man. When she does, Paige tells Spidey that only he can help her, because he too made a deal with the devil.

Initially, Spidey has no idea what Paige is referring to. But when Paige tells him that he made a deal to save the life of someone he loved, Peter begins to remember that terrible day. On some level, he admits, he's always known what he did to save his beloved aunt.

That may be all for naught now, as the angels begin targeting Aunt May herself at the F.E.A.S.T. shelter. If she's only alive now because of Mephisto, then they may feel her life is forfeit. It's up to Spidey and the newly reformed Avengers to save her life once again.

Naturally, this raises a lot of questions about the immediate future of the Spider-Man franchise. The most obvious question is what it all means for Peter and MJ's relationship. Apart from a very brief rekindling of their romance in 2018 (before the infamous Paul Rabin stepped in), Peter and MJ have been broken up since the end of One More Day in 2007. Thanks to Mephisto's meddling, their marriage now never existed in the first place. Will Peter and MJ remember what they sacrificed, and will this cause them to get back together?

All of this is part of Zdarsky's larger interconnected plans for the Marvel Universe. The writer told The Beat , "It’s the joy of Marvel. It’s the joy of the interconnectedness of everything that you can spin things off into different series, and storylines become a new thing as a result of working with the character for a while. Doom is so fun to write. Like, I pitched stuff in the room last week about Doom for like two years from now. Because I’m just like, ‘Oh, wouldn’t this be cool?’ So yeah, Mephisto is, it’s the devil. Writing the devil is a lot of fun."

We'll see exactly how the current Avengers storyline plays out. Marvel is already teasing some big developments ahead in issue #2 , as it seems Mephisto will be assembling his own Sinister Six that includes Sabretooth, Carnage, the Abomination, Kraven the Hunter, and Green Goblin.

Ultimately, though, it may be up to The Amazing Spider-Man writer Joe Kelly to decide how the dissolution of the One More Day bargain impacts Peter's personal life. Currently, Peter is dealing with other problems on the Aunt May front , as her estranged son Cormac has literally stolen her memories of Peter and cut Peter out of her life.

But once that's resolved, we suspect Peter and May are going to have to sit down and have a long overdue conversation about what he sacrificed for her sake. One of the many reasons One More Day has proven so controversial over the years is that many fans have argued that May would be horrified to learn Peter chose her over his wife and unborn daughter. Peter and MJ may finally face a reckoning for that choice, and they'll certainly have to decide how to move forward now that the truth is finally laid bare.

Do you think Peter and MJ will finally get back together now that One More Day has been undone? Vote in our poll and let us know your thoughts in the comments below.

Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

articles.title: Obsession Director Curry Barker Wants to Make a ‘F**ked Up, R-Rated’ Indiana Jones Movie
articles.summary: Curry Barker, famous for his hit horror flick Obsession, is keen on bringing his terrifying tastes to the world of Indiana Jones if the opportunity ever arises.
articles.body:
Curry Barker, famous for his hit horror movie Obsession, is keen on bringing his terrifying tastes to the world of Indiana Jones if the opportunity ever arises.

Barker shared his vision for an especially grisly take on Indy’s adventures during a conversation with Gold Derby after the outlet brought up similar remarks made by Cooper Tomlinson, Barker’s longtime collaborator who co-wrote, produced, and starred in Obsession as Ian, Bear’s best friend.

"I would want to do a really f**ked up, rated-R version of [ Indiana Jones ],” Barker said. “I want to do a crazy adventure movie. That's something that Cooper and I have talked about, because we feel like we've never seen something like that; we've only ever seen the family-friendly version.

“But what happens if two regular guys, or one regular guy, goes on a journey that turns crazy? Literally pushing the boundaries of that genre would be fun for me."

Indiana Jones and the Great Circle Switch 2 Screenshots

As previously mentioned, Tomlinson feels a similar way, hoping to bring back the action-adventure films that defined cinema through the '80s and '90s.

"I'd love to bring back the adventure epic like Raiders of the Lost Ark ," he told the outlet. "What really worked with Obsession was making something that was honest and grounded in reality; obviously we can all suspend disbelief and enjoy all the crazy action stuff that isn't real. But when it comes to the characters and story, it should be more grounded and honest. That's how we're going to get those kinds of action classics back."

Speaking of action-adventure movies that defined the '90s, Michael Johnston (who played Bear in Obsession) has been cast in the next Mummy movie, which will also feature the return of Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. Also speaking with Golden Derby , he described the contrast between filming a small-budget indie horror movie like Obsession and a grand, big-budget picture like The Mummy: Book of the Dead as “really different.”

"These productions are like a well-oiled machine; we do a scene many, many times from many, many different angles, which is nice because it gives us the opportunity to work things out. That takes the pressure off in a way," he said.

"But there's also a lot more waiting around on those sets than on indie films. With something like Obsession, you only have a couple chances to get something done, and you're also helping everyone else out behind the scenes. I'm not doing that on The Mummy; I'm sitting back in my chair and enjoying the catering. But getting to work with Brendan and Rachel is great, and [directors] Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett are the most lovely guys."

The Mummy: Book of the Dead is scheduled to release on October 15, 2027. Barker’s next movie, a horror-comedy called Anything But Ghosts , is also releasing next year in May.

articles.title: Animated John Wick Prequel Film in the Works Starring Keanu Reeves
articles.summary: Keanu Reeves is returning as John Wick in an animated film that aims to tell the assassin’s story before the tragic events of the first movie.
articles.body:
Keanu Reeves is returning as John Wick in an animated film that aims to tell the assassin’s story before the tragic events of the first movie.

The animated flick will be produced by the same team that produced the John Wick movies , comprised of Thunder Road’s Basil Iwanyk and Erica Lee, 87Eleven Entertainment’s Chad Stahelski, and, of course, Keanu Reeves. Point Grey will join the group to produce, as well.

Reeves is also set to reprise his role as the ‘Baba Yaga.’ As told by Lionsgate, this movie will “go back in time to tell the story of John Wick before the first film, as he completes the Impossible Task in order to free himself from his obligation to the High Table and earn the right to be with the love of his life, Helen.” (It’ll be nice to see John Wick being happy, for once.)

Shannon Tindle, an Emmy Award-winning director, writer, and producer known for works like Ultraman: Rising and Kubo and the Two Strings is set to direct. Screenwriting duo Ryan and Kaz Firpo are onboard to write the film; the two are known for Marvel’s Eternals .

This is the latest news we’ve gotten from this highly-anticipated project after it was first announced last year. Adam Fogelson, motion picture chair at Lionsgate, gave fans a little something to chew on during its announcement, saying, “In both animation and the world of ‘John Wick,’ the possibilities are endless. And there is no ‘John Wick’ story fans are clamoring for more than the ‘Impossible Task.’ Shannon’s take on that story is an incredible one, and we are beyond excited to see what John Wick can do in animation.”

The specific animation house responsible for bringing John Wick’s action-packed, assassin-filled world to life has not yet been officially announced. For now, it’s anyone’s guess as to what it will eventually look like, but it’s certainly exciting news while we wait for John Wick 5.

Yes, a fifth movie installment is going to happen, despite the fourth movie appearing to end on a perfect note. The film was first revealed in April 2025, with Fogelson most recently saying that director “Chad [Stahelski] and Keanu have an idea that they think can be really exciting.”

Previously, Stahelski said a script was in active development, though the actual story seemed to be eluding him and fellow writer Mike Finch.

“I’m not going to lie to you, it’s a bit of a conundrum. Me and Mike Finch — the writer on 4 who’s also writing 5 — we’ve got a pretty good story that I think is cool. Once we have a 50-page book, and if we’re feeling it, we’ll sit with Keanu and shape this thing. Look, everybody seems to want it. It’s a matter of whether we crack it. We’re actively working on it. It’s just … is it going to be satisfying?” he said in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter.

These aren’t the only John Wick projects in the works; Reeves is also portraying the titular character in a video game from Saber Interactive, coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox X|S, and PC at an as-yet unreleased date. An official blurb described what players can expect from the title, saying, “Saber's design will be faithful to the unique style and signature elements of the series, including a distinct gun fu combat system, jaw-dropping camerawork, immersive driving experiences, and a variety of memorable environments, all crafted to make players feel like they are in a John Wick movie, playing the role of John Wick himself."
